title: Treasury Hasn't Done Enough to Lower Yields, iCapital's Suzuki Says
summary: Dan Suzuki, global investment strategist at iCapital, discusses the Treasury's recent attempts to lower long-term yields, arguing that the measures taken so far are insufficient and largely symbolic. title: US's Iran Threat Risks Clash With China; Druckenmiller Criticizes Bond Plan|Bloomberg Brief 08/25/26
summary: US equity futures rise after chipmakers rebound. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's plans to isolate Iran risks heightening tensions between the US and China, Tehran's main trading partner. Billionaire investor Stanley Druckenmiller criticizes Bessent's plan to spend billions buying back US bonds. Canada is set to announce a range of measures to protect its workers and businesses from 50% US tariffs. Henry Allen of Deutsche Bank sees market risks on the upside amid a borrowing binge in the AI sector. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: South Africa’s Rand, Bonds Gain as Auction Draws Strong Demand

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Aug. 25
summary: Oil extended declines after a US plan to ramp up economic pressure on Iran spared the country’s trading partners from harsher measures for now, while mediators said they were continuing efforts to end the conflict.

title: Treasury Can Send Strong Signal to Market, Swiber Says
summary: Meghan Swiber, managing director of US rates strategy at BofA Securities, says the US Treasury can cut issuance at the back end of the yield curve, which she says would send a more impactful message to the market. Swiber also talks about what Fed Chair Kevin Warsh may say at Jackson Hole later this week. She speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Russia Eyes Grain Duty Pause This Year on Ukraine Strikes

title: Hungary Cuts Interest Rate Again With Inflation at Decade-Low

title: India’s New Stock Auction Avoids Major Hiccups on Monthly Expiry
